PDF GPU Isosurface Raycasting of FCC Datasets
Abstract This paper presents an e cient and accurate isosurface rendering algorithm for the natural C1 splines on the face-centered cubic (FCC) lattice. Leveraging fast and accurate evaluation of a spline eld and its gradient, accompanied by e cient empty-space skipping, the approach generates high-quality isosurfaces of FCC datasets at interactive speed (20{70 fps).
